method: Read the frozen workbook Quality Checks row 38 and corresponding Internal Quality Checks annotation, the frozen skill and its quality/deterministic references, the frozen staged template, review policy, and all three frozen scored prompts and judge definitions. Parsed judge.toml with Python tomllib; no configured judge or private checker was run.
observations: The workbook Quality Checks row 38 requires each scored criterion to be scored separately and work to continue after a failure; the frozen quality reference lines 156-159 states the same test, and the workbook deterministic sheet names check-batched-independence-wording.py at sheet row 5.
All three frozen scored judge.toml files parse as mode=batched and aggregation=weighted_mean, containing 80 functional, 6 polish, and 6 visual criteria respectively.

Functional prompt lines 9-11 requires every row's result, continuation after a product failure, and independent fallback. Lines 100 and 112 prohibit inheriting sibling verdicts or cascading failures. Lines 445 and 460 explicitly preserve independent credit in complex shared protocols.

Polish prompt lines 22 and 36-40 says an ordinary feature failure does not zero unrelated criteria, and explicitly directs independent scoring and continuation. Line 51 preserves separate keyboard-tour observations after a label/navigation miss.

Visual prompt lines 52-56 explicitly directs independent scoring and continuation, including a per-criterion response to an unviewable surface. Lines 15-16 distinguish a functional failure from a visual defect.

The conditional global browser gate in each scored prompt is a separately stated prerequisite, not a criterion failure. The frozen template itself carries the same gate pattern; the current functional prompt line 5 says ordinary failures remain local, while polish lines 20-22 and visual lines 38-40 restrict all-zero behavior to the prerequisite.

thought_experiments.broken_app: A playground with working Run and keyboard navigation but a broken history Restore should lose the Restore criterion while retaining observed Run, reachability, focus, and visual credit. The functional prompt's shared-scenario rule and the polish/visual continuation rules direct this result.
thought_experiments.conforming_alternative: A server-rendered library with no separate JSON/list endpoint can still satisfy the browser prerequisite; all three current scored prompts explicitly allow a server-rendered document, so that implementation is not zeroed before independent scoring.

limit: This is a static instruction review. No full configured judge execution or private checker output was observed, so it does not establish actual model compliance or candidate readiness.
